name: ApplyPack
description: ApplyPack is a self-hosted AI console for the whole job search. It watches job sources, checks the postings are real, scores your resume against them, drafts cover letters and tracks each application.

notes.text: ApplyPack has no sign-in by default. Set WEB_BASIC_AUTH=username:password in /opt/applypack/.env and run 'systemctl restart applypack applypack-web' before exposing it beyond a trusted network.

Pick an AI engine under Settings > AI engine. API keys can be pasted there or set in /opt/applypack/.env; CLI engines (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex) are installed and need a one-time login in the container.
The database is a local PostgreSQL 16 (database and user 'applypack'). The generated password is in /opt/applypack/.env as DATABASE_URL.
